title: Syrphidae of Italy (SoI)
description:
Versioned data releases of Syrphidae of Italy (SoI), the open catalogue of Italian hoverflies (Diptera: Syrphidae) built in TaxonWorks: names, synonymy and classification, references, and specimen and observation records. Each release is a frozen snapshot with counts and the list of changes since the previous release. The occurrence records are the same data published on GBIF (doi:10.15468/faryxm).

Website: https://syrphidaeitaly.com

creators.name: Dal Pos, Davide
creators.affiliation: Enns Entomology Museum, University of Missouri
